context: Two analysts compare branch performance reports
purpose: Teach: 指数/媒体/正規/相対/保持/バックナンバー/チャート/マクロ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ケンジさん、各支店の業績チャートをまとめておきました。
lines.en: Kenji, I've compiled the performance charts for each branch.
lines.style: Polite, businesslike tone with crisp delivery and slight pride in completed work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとう。前期比の指数で見ると、新宿支店が突出してるね。
lines.en: Thanks. Looking at the index versus last period, the Shinjuku branch really stands out.
lines.style: Calm analytical voice, focused on data, with a touch of mild surprise.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうなんです。広告媒体の選定が功を奏したみたいで、相対的に他より伸びています。
lines.en: Right. Their choice of advertising media seems to have paid off, growing more relatively than others.
lines.style: Engaged and explanatory, slightly leaning forward with measured enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 正規の評価基準だけだと見落としそうな差だな。マクロな視点でも整理しておきたい。
lines.en: It's a gap you might miss using only the standard evaluation criteria. I'd like to organize it from a macro perspective too.
lines.style: Thoughtful and deliberate, voice dropping slightly as he reasons aloud.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 過去三年分の月次データも保持していますので、必要でしたらバックナンバーから取り出しておきます。
lines.en: I've kept the monthly data for the past three years, so I can pull it out from the back issues if needed.
lines.style: Helpful and efficient, professional tone with quiet confidence in her preparation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かるよ。会議では示唆に富む比較になりそうだ。
lines.en: That's a great help. It should make for a suggestive comparison at the meeting.
lines.style: Warmer now, genuinely appreciative, voice softening into collegial gratitude.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では資料に追記して、適宜共有させていただきますね。
lines.en: Then I'll add it to the materials and share them with you as appropriate.
lines.style: Crisp closing tone, slight bow audible in voice, neatly wrapping up the exchange.
